subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.

subject: elapsed time
fact: Eight hours pass between two events in the session.
source_quote: eight hours of rest

subject: chasme count
fact: Four earth elementals are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: Four massive earth elementals rose from the ground

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: The town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: eight days away via the Darklake

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Earth Temple territory
fact: The party now controls a significant portion of the Earth Temple's territory, including the area cleared of gnolls and bugbears.
source_quote: Romag granted them the territory they had cleared of gnolls and bugbears as their own base within the Earth Temple

subject: platinum pieces value
fact: Platinum pieces hidden in a brazier are worth a considerable sum.
source_quote: discovering considerable treasure including platinum pieces hidden in a brazier

subject: three-dragon ante set value
fact: The three-dragon ante set is a valuable and rare gaming artifact.
source_quote: a three-dragon ante set

subject: ritual sacrifice
fact: Romag performs a ritual sacrifice in the great chamber, shoving dirt into Krell's mouth as the traitor screams.
source_quote: Romag stood atop the pyramid and began chanting... shoving dirt into Krell's mouth

subject: charred library
fact: The charred library contains burned remains of books on evil philosophy, double-dealing, self-advancement, and treachery.
source_quote: a charred library filled with the burned remains of books on evil philosophy, double-dealing, self-advancement, and treachery

subject: ritual chamber
fact: The ritual chamber has rough-hewn sandstone walls, a floor of dark brown earth, and is dimly illuminated by phosphorescent lichen.
source_quote: a vast ritual chamber with rough-hewn sandstone walls and a floor of dark brown earth, dimly illuminated by phosphorescent lichen

subject: ornate corridors
fact: The ornate corridors are made of polished brown marble veined with black and inlaid with yellow triangular patterns, lit by burning bronze crescents.
source_quote: ornate corridors of polished brown marble veined with black and inlaid with yellow triangular patterns, lit by burning bronze crescents

subject: hand crossbow contraption value
fact: Lieutenant Krell's hand crossbow contraption—a pistol of his own devising—is a unique and dangerous weapon.
source_quote: wielding a peculiar hand crossbow contraption—a pistol of his own devising

subject: Krell's betrayal
fact: Lieutenant Krell reveals his betrayal by saying, 'I told you they would try to kill you. The Fire Temple protects its own.'
source_quote: I told you they would try to kill you. The Fire Temple protects its own.

subject: Krell's ambush
fact: The gnolls spring their ambush, catching the guards in nets and slaughtering them mercilessly, as screams of 'It's a trap!' echo.
source_quote: Screams of 'It's a trap!' echoed through the corridors as the gnolls sprang their ambush, catching the guards in nets and slaughtering them mercilessly

subject: ritual conclusion
fact: The four earth elementals tear Krell's body apart in a gruesome display before descending back into the earth.
source_quote: the elementals tore Krell's body apart in a gruesome display of the Earth Temple's brutal justice before descending back into the earth

subject: secret door
fact: A secret door leads deeper into the complex, discovered after the ritual chamber.
source_quote: They discovered another secret door before continuing their investigation.

subject: promotion rumor
fact: Rumors spread that Krell's death has created opportunities for promotion within the Earth Temple.
source_quote: rumors about Krell's death creating opportunities for promotion

subject: written permission
fact: Romag provides the party with written permission to explore freely within the Earth Temple.
source_quote: He provided them with written permission to explore freely

subject: Romag's warning
fact: Romag warns the party that having territory makes them targets, as promotion within the temple often comes by stepping over the bodies of rivals.
source_quote: he cautioned that having territory made them targets, as promotion within the temple often came by stepping over the bodies of rivals

subject: party's infiltration
fact: The party has successfully infiltrated the Temple of Elemental Evil, earned Romag's trust, and established their own base of operations deep within the enemy stronghold.
source_quote: The party had successfully infiltrated the Temple of Elemental Evil, earned Romag's trust, and established their own base of operations deep within the enemy stronghold
